Compiled successfully. I created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/DiffBuilderAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering:

- The `builder()` factory and every `DiffBuilder.Builder` setter (fluent `this` returns, null-acceptance for style/format, NPE when `build()` is called with an unset left/right).
- Both deprecated constructors, including the documented NPE-on-null-left/right contract and the trivially-equal short-circuit (`lhs == rhs` or `lhs.equals(rhs)`) for the 3-arg form, and the `testObjectsEquals` flag's override behavior for the 4-arg form.
- `getLeft()`/`getRight()` (accessible as package-private, same package).
- Every `append(...)` overload (boolean/byte/char/double/float/int/long/short, their array forms, `Object`, `Object[]`, and `DiffResult`): each asserts the fluent `this` return, that equal values record no diff while differing values do (verified via the documented `DiffResult.toString()`), plus boundary cases (array length mismatches, empty arrays) and null-`fieldName`/null-`diffResult` NPEs per the documented contract.
- The documented `TO_STRING_FORMAT` constant value.

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
